content.short: Your smart decentralized launchpad for minting, vesting, offering your tokens!
content.description:
T Minus One (T-1) is a decentralized token launchpad on Cardano. It serves as an all-inclusive service for founding projects, providing services for token minting, initial sale, vesting, tokenomics, and more.

The features are entirely governed through Smart Contracts, which removes a crucial component of risk for investors. The Smart Contracts verify that the sale is correctly implemented, vesting schedules are adhered to and liquidity is provided correctly on DEXs. Overall, T-1 revolutionizes the currently cumbersome and error-prone practice of token launches on Cardano by providing unified and standardized tooling.
